theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_fr_card_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → μ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 1) ≠ ∞ → ∀ T : Finset (Euclid P), (∀ σ ∈ T, ‖σ‖ = 1) → (∀ σ ∈ T, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ρ ≤ μ (ball σ ρ)) → (T.card : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * μ (ball 0 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
